description: This file defines the PartialEmployee class in the OrangeHRM LDAP DTO namespace. It serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for partial employee information, including employee ID and work email, with methods to set, get, and create an instance from an Employee object.

classes.name: PartialEmployee
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for carrying partial employee details, including employee ID and work email, with methods to initialize from an Employee object.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID and returns the current instance for method chaining.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setWorkEmail
methods.description: Sets the work email and returns the current instance for method chaining.

methods.name: createFromEmployee
methods.description: Creates a new PartialEmployee instance populated with data from an Employee object.
